maddeler.e:
تناحرت (form VI)
# تَنَاحَرْتُ (tanāḥartu) /ta.naː.ħar.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَنَاحَرَ (tanāḥara)
# تَنَاحَرْتَ (tanāḥarta) /ta.naː.ħar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَنَاحَرَ (tanāḥara)
# تَنَاحَرْتِ (tanāḥarti) /ta.naː.ħar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَنَاحَرَ (tanāḥara)
# تَنَاحَرَتْ (tanāḥarat) /ta.naː.ħa.rat/: third-person fem
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
